item.title: Probation officers in England and Wales vote for industrial action
item.body: Members of the Napo union backed overtime restrictions and other action short of a strike over pay and workloads. The vote deals a blow to government plans to release thousands of prisoners early to tackle overcrowding.

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | ⚖️ Probation officers in England and Wales vote for industrial action

Members of the Napo union backed overtime restrictions and other action short of a strike over pay and workloads. The vote deals a blow to government plans to release thousands of prisoners early to tackle overcrowding.

Source: Guardian | Image: Pixabay
UK Daily Briefing | 13 November, 21:40
